accepted_items.title: The Yin-Yang Master: Dream of Eternity

rejection_summary: The Thousand Faces of Dunjia — strong supernatural powers, creatures and CGI action, but reviews consistently describe a cartoony/slapstick register, loose worldbuilding and effects-heavy chaos; it was not strong enough for the live mature-fantasy profile.
The Legend of Hei — rich spirit powers, factions and frequent fantasy action, but its cute all-ages/family register is a poor fit for the profile's mature presentation preference.
The Soul Snatcher — considered as a fox-spirit fantasy candidate, but available evidence was not strong enough to support a complete high-confidence live DNA vector above the acceptance threshold.
